graphs: GO top50 file, official top20 filtering

architecture.perturbation: official Exphormer-MG: 4 layers, hidden128, 2 heads, expander degree3, reverse edges, self loops, multihot typed edges
architecture.output: native unconstrained absolute expression mean; no clipping, no generated cloud

benchmark.scope: known perturbation, unseen environment, shared genes

data_adaptations.benchmark_task: five environment holdouts, same known targets
data_adaptations.control: matched per environment full pooled E mean, not truncated E-shape mean; replaces native cell-type/batch matched means because benchmark fixes this reference
data_adaptations.target_graph_ids: audited one-to-one HGNC symbol mapping; ambiguous/missing/duplicate names retain unique stable IDs and learned isolated nodes; no dropped targets
data_adaptations.input_output_axis: all fixed 5979 genes, no HVG selection
data_adaptations.benchmark_normalization: use frozen totalA2048 per10000 log1p; do not renormalize

training.task_weights: fresh for each fold and seed; never warm-start across runs
training.objective: unchanged official model.loss, mse_weight=1; real individual cells, all output genes
training.epoch: 64 cells sampled uniformly with replacement per permitted condition, plus64 control cells per train environment; globally shuffle cell examples
training.graph_backward: full official graph recomputed with autograd every minibatch; no frozen graph embeddings
training.selection: lowest finite weighted native real-cell MSE; environment weights external1/2, internal1/6 each; all nonzero validated epochs eligible
training.convergence: 6 non-improving checks after minimum budget; last LR reduction at least2 epochs earlier
training.lr_policy: halve after2 and4 non-improving eligible checks, min1e-6; explicit benchmark wrapper policy
training.resume: same fold/seed and method spec only; full model, graph attributes, optimizer and RNG states
training.original_training_entrypoint: not published in official repository; benchmark wrapper trains the official model/loss/optimizer

evaluation.publication_table: mean-only table; not eligible for native distribution table
evaluation.primary_metrics: unchanged frozen response_metrics: Rdelta, MSE,MAE,RMSE,Pearson,Spearman,PDS,raw cosine,JAC20/50/100,signedTopK,strong-response NMAE,direction,amplitude; absolute mean MSE/MAE and native cell MSE additionally
evaluation.strong_threshold: q95(abs(training P mean - full E mean)), max .001; training conditions only
evaluation.clipping: none, matching native official decoder; negative prediction fraction reported
evaluation.PDS: raw response cosine, exclude all panel target genes, exact equality midrank; internal metric not official VCC score
evaluation.final_validation: all1525 external conditions reported only after selection
evaluation.final_test: all1525 test conditions; sealed before own test truth reads
evaluation.aggregation: per fold: mean/sample SD/sample variance over3seeds; overall mean/sample SD/sample variance across5fold means

user_distribution_decision: user requested native mean only if distribution adapter would be custom; no custom distribution generation
